cues.en: Hello and welcome back.
Today, we're talking about the bias-variance trade off.
cues.zh: 今天談偏差與變異權衡。

cues.en: Alright, so here we've got the same data set three times, and we're going to apply three different models and see what we think of them.
cues.zh: 同一資料集放三次，套三種模型，看看如何。

cues.en: The first model will be applied to the dataset like this.
Now this, even though it's hitting every single point in the data, is not great because it's overfitting.
cues.zh: 即使命中每個點，也不好，因為過度擬合。

cues.en: It's got what is called high variance.
And the way to remember that is that if you change this data, so let's say this is training data, and if you change this data, if this training data is changed, then the model will vary.
cues.zh: 記法是，如果訓練資料改變，模型就大幅改變。

cues.en: So it's very highly fitting.
It's overfitting to the training data.
And so it varies a lot if the training data is changed.
cues.zh: 資料變動，模型就變很多。

cues.en: So this is called overfitting.
The model varies a lot if the training data is changed.
cues.zh: 訓練資料改變，模型大幅變動。

cues.en: The symptoms of this, how can you tell if your model might be overfitting is it's performs very well on the training data.
cues.zh: 症狀是，訓練資料表現非常好。

cues.en: You get greater results, but performs very poorly on the test data.
cues.zh: 結果很好，但測試資料很差。

cues.en: And that's another reason why it's important to have both training data and tested to verify that your model is, in this case, not overfitting, or in this case, it is overfitting.
cues.zh: 這也是為什麼要有訓練與測試資料，確認模型沒有過度擬合，或像這裡有過度擬合。

cues.en: Model two, this one is got high bias and is basically predicting, in this case, very, very high bias.
cues.zh: 第二個模型有高偏差，這裡甚至非常高。

cues.en: It's a very basic model.
The model is too simple.
It's just predicting the same answer for all the points.
cues.zh: 所有點都預測相同答案。

cues.en: So it's fit this line.
This horizontal line is just taking the average of all the values.
cues.zh: 水平線，只取全部值的平均。

cues.en: That's still a model, it's an average model, but like the, it uses the mathematical average as its basis, but it's a bad model
cues.zh: 仍是一個以數學平均為基礎的模型，但很差，

cues.en: because it's underfitting.
It's not seeing any of the patterns, underlying patterns in the data.
cues.zh: 沒看見資料內任何模式。

cues.en: It's not capturing the underlying pattern.
The model is too simple and the symptoms here are, it's bad, it's got bad performance on the training data.
cues.zh: 模型太簡單，症狀是訓練資料表現也差。

cues.en: As soon as you see bad performance on training data, there's a chance your model might be underfitting.
cues.zh: 訓練資料表現差，可能是擬合不足。

cues.en: Might be too simple for your dataset.
So in the case of this model, it's too complex.
It's because of its complexity.
It is like it's sophistication, it's able to capture all the training, but that's also not good.
cues.zh: 能捕捉所有訓練資料，但也不好。

cues.en: In this case, it's too simple.
And then finally, model number three.
As you can see here, it's capturing a underlying trend, underlying pattern in the data, but it's not too simple, not too overfitting,
cues.zh: 能捕捉底層趨勢與模式，不會太簡單，也不至於太複雜而

cues.en: or too sophisticated that it's overfitting.
So it's got a good balance.
And this is called a model is well balanced.
The symptoms are model performs well on both training and test data.
So that's three things.
So this is the trade off between bias and variance.
cues.zh: 就是偏差與變異的權衡。

cues.en: Another way that sometimes this is explained is through the bullseye diagram.
So here, imagine you've got bias, a low bias here, high bias on the vertical axis, and then on the horizontal axis, you've got low variance, high variance.
cues.zh: 垂直軸有低、高偏差，水平軸有低、高變異。

cues.en: So, imagine you're throwing darts at a bullseye at a target.
So if you are constantly throwing darts and you are hitting them all close together, but away from the center, then you have an underfitting situation.
cues.zh: 若一直集中在一起，但遠離中心，就是擬合不足。

cues.en: You have like, if we are talking about models, your model's underfitting.
cues.zh: 對模型來說，就是擬合不足。

cues.en: It's got a high bias, but a low variance.
Now, if you've got an different situation where you're throwing the darts and you're kind of around the center, but your darts are all over the place all the time.
cues.zh: 另一情況是大致圍著中心，但飛鏢四散。

cues.en: They're not all cluster in the center.
They're all as different locations all the time.
That is an overfitting model.
That means you've got low bias, high variance.
If you change the training data, the pattern will change again.
cues.zh: 訓練資料一變，模式又變。

cues.en: It'll kind of be around the center, but the points are never going to be clustered together.
cues.zh: 大致在中心附近，但點不集中。

cues.en: And if you have low bias and low variance, then you're hitting the bullseye all the time.
cues.zh: 低偏差、低變異，則一直命中靶心。

cues.en: You're very close to it.
That's a good balance model.
And of course the opposite situation.
If you have high bias and high variance, you have a terrible model.
cues.zh: 高偏差、高變異，模型很差。

cues.en: You're far away from the center and everything's scattered around.
So that's another way it's explained.
Personally, I prefer the first way that we looked at it.
Nonetheless, here's a quick summary of what we discussed, and that's all you need to know for the exam.
cues.zh: 這裡快速整理，考試知道這些就足夠。

cues.en: And I look forward to you back here next time.
Until then, enjoy the cloud.
cues.zh: 在那之前，享受雲端的樂趣吧。
